title: Tile text reads near-black in light theme and near-white in dark
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. The app's light / dark theme switch is in the profile menu (your initials, top right): Light and Dark.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
custom_steps:
1. Switch the app to the light theme and click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Look at each tile's name, supporting line (e.g. Parts 39% · Labor 61%) and date pill or days pill text.
  3. Look over the whole page: tiles, trend lines, pills, the top bar.
  4. Switch the app to the dark theme.
  5. Repeat the last two looks.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • In the light theme the tile names, supporting lines and pill texts are near-black, clearly darker than a muted grey.
  • In the dark theme the same texts are near-white.
  • In both themes every tile, trend line, pill and text is visible and readable: nothing is invisible against its background, cut off or overlapping.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 12. Split out of C88626. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 01_Opens_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R2: “The descriptive text on the tiles — tile labels, supporting lines, and the date-range and inactivity-window controls — is shown in a near-black color in the light theme.”
  • S12-R3: “The same descriptive text is shown in a near-white color in the dark theme.”
  • S12-R5: “The dashboard renders correctly in both the light and the dark theme.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
